root.name: Slav Defense: Two Knights Attack
root.moves: 1. d4 d5 2. c4 c6 3. Nf3 Nf6 4. Nc3 dxc4

overview: Black takes the c4 pawn and keeps the light-squared bishop outside the chain. The main line is 5.a4 Bf5 6.e3 e6 7.Bxc4 Bb4 8.O-O Nbd7, where White regains the pawn and gets a central majority and Black a solid structure with a sound bishop. 5.Ne5 and other lines are less common.

white_ideas.idea: Regain c4 with Bxc4 and use the centre with e4.
Play a4 to stop ...b5 and develop quickly.

black_ideas.idea: Develop the c8 bishop to f5 before ...e6.
Pin on b4 and prepare ...c5 or ...e5.

typical_structures.structure: White d4/e3 against ...c6/...e6 with a half-open c-file after Bxc4 and ...c5 breaks.

character.notes: Black's structure is sound with the bishop outside the chain; few ways to lose quickly.

gambit.notes: White regains c4 by force; Black's pawn grab is only temporary.

structure.notes: Centre in tension (d4 against c6/e6), White to play e4; QGD-like flexible.

level.notes: Moderate theory with clear plans; typical Intermediate Slav.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.Ne5
sublines_that_differ.how: White aims for quick development and a Qa4 pin; more tactical than the main 5.a4.

character.reason: Black's Slav structure is hard to break down with a good bishop.

soundness.reason: A main line of the Slav.

structure.reason: Central tension rather than a locked or open centre.

level.reason: Plans are clear, theory is moderate.
